test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Her later short stories are vastly __superior than__ her earlier ones.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. superior to .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**superior**" is always followed by the preposition "**to**" when used to compare two things or people.
 
• Using "**than**" or other prepositions such as "from," "over," or "against" with "superior" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Therefore, the correct substitution for the underlined segment "*superior than*" is "**superior to**."

Correct sentence: *Her later short stories are vastly **superior to** her earlier ones*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The adjectives "**inferior**," "**senior**," "**junior**," "**prior**," and "**preferable**" also take the preposition "**to**" instead of "**than**" when making comparisons.
 
• **Example:** He is junior to me in the office, not "junior than me."
